---
title: "Quarto Dashboard with Crosstalk, Sidebar, Tab Layout and Theme Update"
format: 
  dashboard:
    theme: 
      - zephyr
      - theme.scss
orientation: columns

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

#adsl
set.seed(123)

## ---- ADSL: Subject-level dataset ----

n_subj <- 20

adsl <- data.frame(
  SUBJID   = sprintf("SUBJ%03d", 1:n_subj),
  WEIGHTBL = round(rnorm(n_subj, mean = 75, sd = 12), 1),   # kg
  HEIGHTBL = round(rnorm(n_subj, mean = 170, sd = 10), 1),  # cm
  TRT01P   = sample(c("Placebo", "Drug A"), n_subj, replace = TRUE),
  TRTDURD  = sample(30:180, n_subj, replace = TRUE)
)

adsl2 <- adsl %>% 
         select(SUBJID, TRT01P, TRTDURD, WEIGHTBL, HEIGHTBL)

adsl3 <- adsl2 %>% 
         mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

adsl_ct <- SharedData$new(adsl3)

```

## Sidebar {width=20%}

```{r}
#| title: Planned Treatment
#| height: 30%

filter_select("trt", "", adsl_ct, ~ TRT01P)

```

# Data

## Column

```{r}
datatable(adsl_ct,
          extensions = c('ColReorder'), 
          rownames = FALSE, filter = 'top',
          options = list(colReorder = TRUE, lengthMenu = c(14,10)))

```

# Figures

## Column {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Figure 1

f1 <- ggplot(data = adsl_ct, aes(x=TRT01P,y=TRTDURD,fill=TRT01P)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(name="Treatment Group") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,250), breaks=seq(0,250,50), expand=c(0.05,0.05), name="Treatment Duration") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"), name="Treatment Group") +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(f1)


```

```{r}
#| title: Figure 2

f2 <- ggplot(data = adsl_ct, aes(x=WEIGHTBL,y=HEIGHTBL,shape=TRT01P)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(30,110), breaks=seq(30,110,10), name="Baseline Height") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(130,200), breaks=seq(130,200,10), name="Baseline Weight") +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(f2)


```
